question: How do I customize pronunciation when calling the text-to-speech API endpoint?
ground_truth: You can customize pronunciation using pronunciation dictionaries. In the text-to-speech request body, include the pronunciation_dictionary_locators array with objects containing pronunciation_dictionary_id (required) and optionally version_id. Additionally, you can control text normalization behavior using apply_text_normalization with values 'auto', 'on', or 'off', and apply_language_text_normalization (boolean) for language-specific normalization. The text normalization affects how numbers, dates, and special characters are spoken.
